description: AgroVision AI Canonical Disease Registry establishing stable IDs, condition types, verified pathogen types, observable symptoms, look-alikes, dataset aliases, and model class indices across all 75 dataset classes.

observable_symptoms: Dull olive-green to black velvety spots on leaf surface
Crinkled and distorted leaf margins in early stage
Scabby, corky, cracked lesions on apple fruit skin
evidence_references: ICAR-CITH Technical Bulletin on Temperate Fruit Pathology 2022
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Laboratory cardboard background in Dataset 1. Foliar spots visually resemble black rot before sporulation.

observable_symptoms: Small circular purple spots on leaves expanding to frogeye pattern with tan center and dark purple border
Firm brown to black rotting on fruit starting near calyx
Sunken cankers on twigs and branches
evidence_references: Penn State Extension Tree Fruit Production Guide 2023
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Dataset 1 images show isolated leaves with frogeye spotting; fruit rot stage is not represented in dataset.

observable_symptoms: Bright yellow-orange circular spots on upper leaf surface with tiny dark pycnidia
Cluster cups (aecia) protruding from lower leaf surface in mature stage
Yellow swollen spots on calyx end of fruit
evidence_references: Cornell Cooperative Extension Cedar Apple Rust Fact Sheet 2023
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Distinctive yellow-orange color simplifies image classification; only laboratory leaf images available.

observable_symptoms: Uniform green leaf color, intact cuticle, absence of chlorotic halos or necrotic spots
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Dataset 1 shows leaves on plain cardboard under flat artificial lighting.

observable_symptoms: Narrow reddish-brown streaks parallel to leaf veins
Streaks expanding into elliptical dark brown to black spots with grey centers and yellow halos
Extensive leaf blade collapse and drying
evidence_references: ICAR-NRCB Technical Guide on Sigatoka Complex Management 2023
diseases.uncertainty_notes: High visual similarity to Yellow Sigatoka in early streak stage; Dataset 2 contains field photographs.

observable_symptoms: Large oval to diamond-shaped pale brown lesions with distinct concentric zonate rings
Bright yellow border surrounding necrotic lesion
Lesions usually originate from leaf margin and expand inward
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Characterized by concentric zonation and bright yellow halo; 342 images in Dataset 2.

observable_symptoms: Vibrant green leaf blade, broad intact lamina, absence of necrotic streaks or chlorotic spotting
evidence_references: ANGRAU Package of Practices for Banana 2024
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Dataset 2 contains 500 field canopy photographs.

observable_symptoms: Yellowing of lower/older leaves starting from margin and progressing toward midrib
Petiole buckling and leaves collapsing against pseudostem forming skirt of dead leaves
Longitudinal splitting of pseudostem base and internal vascular reddish-brown discoloration
evidence_references: ICAR-NRCB Fusarium Wilt (TR4 / Race 1) Diagnostic Protocol 2023
FAO Global Programme on Banana Fusarium Wilt 2022
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Foliar yellowing can be mistaken for nutrient deficiency without inspecting stem vascular discoloration.

observable_symptoms: Circular to elliptical sunken necrotic spots on ripe red chilli pods with concentric rings of black acervuli
Straw-colored dry rot of pod with shriveled seed cavity
Dieback of twig tips drying downwards into silvery-white twigs
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Dataset 2 contains images of both fruit rot and foliar lesions; non-foliar pod images must not be rejected by leaf-only filters.

observable_symptoms: Pre-emergence seed decay and failure of seedling emergence
Water-soaked brownish constriction of hypocotyl/collar at soil line
Seedlings toppling over in patches in the nursery bed
evidence_references: TNAU Agritech Portal Chilli Damping Off Guide 2022
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Occurs exclusively at nursery/seedling stage (0-30 days); seedling collar photos must be supported.

observable_symptoms: Vibrant green leaves, uniform growth, erect foliage, absence of puckering, spots, or pod lesions
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Major prior attractor in monolithic 72-class model; Potato and Tomato field images misclassified here.

observable_symptoms: Upward curling, puckering, and boat-shaped cupping of leaf margins
Shortening of internodes resulting in severe plant stunting and rosetting
Thickened veins, reduced leaf size, and flower drop with malformed fruit
known_look_alikes: Chilli Thrips damage (Scirtothrips dorsalis - causes upward boat-like curling)
Chilli Mite damage (Polyphagotarsonemus latus - downward curling)
evidence_references: ANGRAU Package of Practices for Chilli (Viral Diseases) 2024
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Transmitted by whitefly vector (*Bemisia tabaci*); thrips and mite feeding cause nearly identical curling symptoms requiring questionnaire differentiation.

diseases.canonical_name: Chilli Cercospora Leaf Spot (Frog Eye Spot)
observable_symptoms: Circular to oblong spots with pale grey/white center and prominent dark brown or reddish margin
Lesions surrounded by prominent chlorotic yellow halo
Severe leaf yellowing and defoliation when spots coalesce
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Distinguished from bacterial spot by grey center and distinct circular shape rather than angular water-soaking.

observable_symptoms: Dark green vein-banding and mottling along primary and secondary leaf veins
Interveinal chlorosis and mild leaf distortion
Slight reduction in plant height without severe rosetting
evidence_references: ICAR-IIVR (Indian Institute of Vegetable Research) Virus Manual 2022
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Aphid-transmitted Potyvirus; lack of leaf curling distinguishes it from ChiLCV.

observable_symptoms: Tiny white-winged insects fluttering when plant is shaken
Scale-like translucent nymphs on underside of leaves
Chlorotic yellow speckling on upper leaf surface, sticky honeydew, and sooty mold development
evidence_references: ANGRAU Chilli Sucking Pest Management Protocol 2024
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Primary vector of ChiLCV; images in Dataset 2 depict underside leaf nymph colonies and sooty honeydew.

observable_symptoms: General yellowing and chlorosis of foliage without diagnostic pathogen structures
evidence_references: AgroVision AI Phase 1 Dataset Quality Audit (docs/TWO_DATASET_QUALITY_REPORT.md)
diseases.uncertainty_notes: EXCLUDED from 72-class model (canonical ID -1). Label conflates multiple abiotic and viral causes. Must not be used for definitive chemical treatment.

observable_symptoms: Tan to gray rectangular lesions strictly bounded by leaf veins
Lesions 1 to 6 cm long forming parallel-sided strips
Extensive blighting and premature death of leaves when lesions coalesce
evidence_references: Purdue Extension Gray Leaf Spot Guide 2022
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Rectangular vein-limited shape is diagnostic; Dataset 1 images show laboratory cardboard backing.

observable_symptoms: Oval to elongate cinnamon-brown powdery pustules on both upper and lower leaf surfaces
Epidermis rupturing to release reddish-brown urediniospores
Pustules turning brownish-black late in season as teliospores form
known_look_alikes: Southern corn rust (Puccinia polysora - smaller orange pustules mainly on upper surface)
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Favored by cool humid conditions (16-25°C); Dataset 1 images only.

observable_symptoms: Deep green arching linear leaves, prominent midrib, smooth margins without pustules or rectangular striping
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Dataset 1 laboratory cardboard images only.

observable_symptoms: Long, elliptical, cigar-shaped grayish-green to tan lesions (2.5 to 15 cm long)
Lesions not restricted by leaf veins (unlike Gray Leaf Spot)
Dark olive-gray fuzzy fungal sporulation inside lesions under humid conditions
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Cigar-shaped lesion morphology is diagnostic; Dataset 1 images only.

observable_symptoms: Small circular brown spots with concentric target-like rings and dark purple margins
Centers of older lesions crack, drop out, producing shot-hole appearance
Premature defoliation during boll development stage
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Concentric ring morphology differentiates it from angular bacterial lesions; 500 field images in Dataset 2.

diseases.canonical_name: Cotton Bacterial Blight (Angular Leaf Spot / Blackarm)
observable_symptoms: Small angular water-soaked lesions strictly delimited by veinlets on lower leaf surface
Lesions turning dark reddish-brown to black on upper surface
Elongated black lesions girdling stems and branches (blackarm phase)
Round water-soaked spots on bolls turning dark and sunken (boll rot phase)
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Verified bacterial pathogen; represented in both Dataset 1 (lab cardboard) and Dataset 2 (field).

observable_symptoms: Loss of turgor and wilting starting from lower leaves and progressing upwards
Yellowing and browning of leaf margins and interveinal areas
Dark brown to black ring of vascular discoloration visible inside stem when split longitudinally
Stunting, browning, and collapse of entire plant
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Vascular stem browning distinguishes it from foliar leaf spots; 500 field images in Dataset 2.

observable_symptoms: Broad palmately lobed green leaves, erect vegetative canopy, absence of angular water-soaking or wilting
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Present in both Dataset 1 and Dataset 2.

observable_symptoms: Interveinal chlorosis and necrosis creating characteristic 'tiger-striped' leaf pattern
Marginal leaf curling and drying, leading to defoliation
Light brown vascular discoloration in outer stem cylinder
Favored by cooler temperatures (20-25°C) and heavy irrigated soils
evidence_references: Texas A&M AgriLife Cotton Disease Guide
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Tiger-stripe leaf pattern is distinctive; 500 field images in Dataset 2.

observable_symptoms: Small circular reddish-brown leaf spots with dark margins and tiny black pycnidia in rings
Infected fruit berries turn soft, brown, and shrivel into hard black wrinkled mummies
Elongated black sunken lesions on canes and petioles
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Dataset 1 shows laboratory leaf spots; fruit mummy phase not represented in dataset.

observable_symptoms: Interveinal chlorosis and necrosis producing 'tiger-stripe' pattern on leaves
Small dark purple to black flecks or speckles ('black measles') on berry skin
Sudden apoplexy (rapid wilting and vine death during hot dry spells)
evidence_references: UC Davis IPM Grape Esca Pest Note 2022
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Complex trunk fungal disease; foliar tiger-striping represented in Dataset 1.

observable_symptoms: Uniformly green lobed vine leaves, smooth surface, intact margins without spots or tiger-striping
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Laboratory cardboard background in Dataset 1.

observable_symptoms: Large irregular reddish-brown necrotic blotches on leaf blades
Olive-brown to black sooty spore growth on underside of lesions
Premature leaf drying and severe defoliation
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Dataset 1 images only; syn. Isariopsis clavispora.

observable_symptoms: Small dark brown to black circular spots coalescing into irregular leaf blights
Blossom blight causing blackening and dropping of panicle flowers
Tear-staining and sunken black rots on maturing and harvested mango fruit
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Dataset 2 contains 500 orchard field photographs covering leaves and fruit.

observable_symptoms: Angular, water-soaked, black raised lesions delimited by leaf veins with yellow chlorotic halos
Lesions oozing bacterial gum droplets in wet weather
Star-shaped cracks with black margins on developing mango fruits leading to fruit drop
evidence_references: ICAR-CISH Bacterial Diseases of Subtropical Fruits 2023
EPPO Global Database on Xanthomonas citri pv. mangiferaeindicae
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Verified bacterial pathogen; distinguished from anthracnose by angular vein-limited margins and star-shaped fruit cracking.

observable_symptoms: Clean, sharp, transverse cut across the tender leaf blade as if cut with scissors
Basal portion of leaf remains attached to shoot while distal half drops to orchard floor
Damage occurs exclusively on new emerging copper-colored flush leaves
evidence_references: TNAU Agritech Portal Mango Insect Pests 2023
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Pest damage; clean scissor-like transverse cut on tender flush is pathognomonic.

observable_symptoms: Drying of twigs and branches progressing from top downwards (dieback)
Leaves on affected branches wither, turn brown, and remain attached to dead twigs
Brown discoloration of vascular bundles when bark is scraped
Gum exudation from diseased branches
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Twig and branch drying with persistent dead foliage; 500 field images in Dataset 2.

observable_symptoms: Small raised pimple-like or wart-like galls on upper and lower leaf surfaces
Galls initially pale green turning reddish-brown and finally black with exit holes
Severe gall density causes crinkling, curling, and premature leaf drop
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Pest damage; physical blister galls on leaf blade are easily distinguished from flat fungal spots.

observable_symptoms: Dark green leathery lanceolate leaves, smooth surface, prominent venation, zero galls, spots, or dieback
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Dataset 2 contains 500 outdoor orchard photographs.

observable_symptoms: White to grayish powdery fungal growth on leaves, flower panicles, and young fruits
Infected flower buds fail to open and drop off causing severe yield loss
Distortion, purplish-brown blotching, and curling of young leaves
diseases.uncertainty_notes: White powdery coating is diagnostic; attacks panicles during December-February flowering.

observable_symptoms: Superficial black, velvety or crusty fungal layer covering upper leaf surface
Fungal layer peels off in dry flakes, revealing green leaf tissue underneath
Associated with heavy infestation of sap-sucking mango hoppers (*Idioscopus* spp.)
evidence_references: ICAR-CISH Mango Sooty Mould Management Sheet 2023
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Non-parasitic superficial fungus growing on insect honeydew; primary management requires hopper control.

observable_symptoms: Absence of botanical crop foliage, fruit, stem, or plant organ features
evidence_references: AgroVision AI Baseline Evaluation and OOD Rejection Protocol 2026
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Out-of-Distribution rejection class. Used to train selective prediction to abstain on non-plant inputs.

observable_symptoms: Asymmetric, blotchy mottle chlorosis crossing leaf veins
Yellow vein clearing, corky vein thickening, and small upright leaves
Lopsided, poorly colored fruit with inverted coloration (green at bottom when ripe) and aborted seeds
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Phloem-limited unculturable bacterium transmitted by Asian citrus psyllid (*Diaphorina citri*). Dataset 1 lab leaves.

observable_symptoms: Glossy dark green winged-petiole leaves, uniform color, absence of blotchy mottle or vein corking
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Dataset 1 laboratory cardboard images only.

observable_symptoms: Olive-green to bright orange-yellow discoloration of older fronds exposed to sunlight
Shaded portions of leaflets under overlapping fronds remain green
Necrotic desiccation and orange frond tips in advanced stages
evidence_references: ICAR-IIOPR (Pedavegi) Oil Palm Nutrition and Nutrient Deficiencies Atlas 2023
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Abiotic nutritional disorder, not an infectious pathogen. 59 images in Dataset 2.

observable_symptoms: Dense crust of small dark thread-like waxy scale coverings on lower surface of leaflets
Yellow chlorotic spots on upper leaf surface directly opposite feeding sites
Frond desiccation, yellowing, and premature senescence in severe infestations
evidence_references: ICAR-IIOPR Insect Pests of Oil Palm Manual 2023
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Armored scale insect pest damage; 142 field images in Dataset 2.

observable_symptoms: Premature drying, wilting, and brown desiccated tips of lower fronds due to drought
evidence_references: AgroVision AI Phase 1 Dataset Quality Audit
diseases.uncertainty_notes: EXCLUDED from 72-class model (canonical ID -1). Label lacks pathology differentiation; 70 images in Dataset 2.

observable_symptoms: General necrotic foliar spotting of oil palm fronds
evidence_references: AgroVision AI Phase 1 Dataset Quality Audit
diseases.uncertainty_notes: EXCLUDED from 72-class model (canonical ID -1). Extremely small sample size (25 images) and generic undifferentiated label.

observable_symptoms: Small, irregular, water-soaked dark spots on leaves with pale yellow halos
Spots turn brown to black and coalesce, causing leaf tearing and extensive defoliation
Raised, wart-like brown scab lesions on green bell pepper fruit
evidence_references: TNAU Agritech Portal Bell Pepper Protection 2023
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Dataset 1 images show greenhouse/lab bell pepper leaves; distinct from hot field chilli (*Capsicum annuum* hot cultivars).

observable_symptoms: Broad, dark green ovate leaves, glossy surface, absence of water-soaked spots or puckering
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Dataset 1 laboratory cardboard images only.

observable_symptoms: Dark brown to black necrotic spots with characteristic concentric rings (target-board pattern)
Yellow chlorotic halo surrounding lesions
Lesions start on older lower leaves and cause premature senescence
Sunken, dark, leathery dry rot on potato tubers with raised borders
evidence_references: University of Idaho Potato Early Blight Guide
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Concentric rings are diagnostic. Represented only in Dataset 1 (40 train images on cardboard). High risk of field misclassification as healthy chilli.

observable_symptoms: Compound pinnate green leaves, smooth leaflets, absence of concentric spots, water-soaking, or wilting
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Dataset 1 laboratory cardboard images only.

observable_symptoms: Large, irregular water-soaked pale to dark green lesions turning rapidly purplish-brown or black
White delicate fuzzy fungal-like sporulation on underside of leaves at lesion margin during humid morning hours
Rapid collapse, foul rot smell, and destruction of entire potato canopy in 3-7 days during cool wet weather
Brown granular dry rot extending 5-15 mm into tuber flesh
evidence_references: ICAR-CPRI Late Blight Forecasting and Management Guide 2023
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Devastating oomycete pathogen (Irish Potato Famine). Dataset 1 only; zero field images in Dataset 2.

observable_symptoms: Water-soaked stripes starting near leaf tips and margins, rapidly turning yellow to grayish-white with wavy edges
Bacterial ooze droplets (amber-colored beads) drying into encrustations on young lesions in morning dew
Kresek phase (systemic wilt of entire seedlings) 1-3 weeks after transplanting
known_look_alikes: Drying of leaf tips due to salinity
evidence_references: ANGRAU Rice Protection Package of Practices 2024
IRRI Rice Knowledge Bank: Bacterial Blight
diseases.uncertainty_notes: CRITICAL PHASE 1 RESOLUTION: Verified bacterial pathogen. Casing mismatch in legacy metadata caused generic fungal fallback. Now strictly categorized as bacterial.

observable_symptoms: Spindle-shaped / diamond-shaped / eye-shaped lesions with gray or whitish centers and brown or reddish margins
Lesions coalescing to blight entire leaf blade
Blackening and rotting of panicle neck (neck blast) causing blank, white, erect panicles
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Spindle shape with grey center is diagnostic. Represented in both Dataset 1 and Dataset 2.

observable_symptoms: Small circular to oval dark brown spots resembling sesame seeds with yellow chlorotic halos
Lesion center turns grey or whitish as spot matures
Velvety black fungal growth on infected glumes and discolored seeds
evidence_references: IRRI Rice Knowledge Bank: Brown Spot
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Associated with poor soil fertility (silicon/potassium/nitrogen deficiency); 460 images in Dataset 2.

observable_symptoms: Erect bright green linear leaf blades, smooth ligule and auricles, absence of spindle lesions or marginal blighting
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Present in both Dataset 1 and Dataset 2.

observable_symptoms: Zonate chevron-like bands of alternating light tan and dark olive-brown drying starting from leaf tip
Distinct wavy or scalloped margins on advancing blighted areas
Entire leaf drying out and taking on a bleached scalded appearance
evidence_references: IRRI Rice Knowledge Bank: Leaf Scald
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Chevron zonation starting at tips is diagnostic; 500 field images in Dataset 2.

observable_symptoms: Small, slightly raised, angular black leaden spots (0.5 to 2 mm long) scattered on mature leaf blades
Spots covered by leaf epidermis which ruptures during wet weather to expose black spore mass
Leaves turn prematurely yellow from the tip when spot density is high
evidence_references: IRRI Rice Knowledge Bank: Leaf Smut
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Small sample count in Dataset 2 (only 40 images). Minor economic importance; black angular leaden spots.

observable_symptoms: Oval or oblong greenish-gray water-soaked lesions on leaf sheaths near water line
Lesions expand into large irregular serpent-like blotches with bleached grey centers and dark brown margins
Lesions spreading up tillers onto upper leaves in dense canopies; brown sclerotia visible on lesions
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Crucially affects lower leaf sheaths; photographs of lower stem/tillers must be supported. 500 images in Dataset 2.

diseases.scientific_name: Rice tungro bacilliform virus & Rice tungro spherical virus
observable_symptoms: Yellow to deep orange discoloration of leaves starting from the tips and progressing downward
Severe plant stunting, reduced tillering, and delayed flowering
Panicles small, sterile, or only partially exerted with discolored grains
evidence_references: ICAR-IIRR Tungro Epidemiology and Management Guide 2023
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Viral disease complex transmitted by green leafhopper (*Nephotettix virescens*). 500 field images in Dataset 2.

observable_symptoms: Small, dark, circular to irregular water-soaked spots (< 3 mm) on leaves
Lesion centers dry, turn dark brown to black with yellow halos
Black raised blister-like scab lesions on green tomato fruits
evidence_references: University of Florida Extension Bacterial Spot Guide
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Bacterial pathogen; represented in both Dataset 1 and Dataset 2.

observable_symptoms: Dark brown to black necrotic spots with concentric target-board ridges
Surrounding tissue turns chlorotic yellow, leading to defoliation from base upward
Sunken, dark, leathery lesions at stem end of tomato fruit
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Concentric rings are diagnostic. Represented in both Dataset 1 and Dataset 2.

observable_symptoms: Compound pinnate green leaves, serrated margins, absence of chlorotic yellowing, spots, or curling
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Present in both Dataset 1 and Dataset 2.

observable_symptoms: Large, irregular water-soaked pale green lesions rapidly expanding and turning dark brown to black
White cottony sporulation visible on underside of leaves in cool humid conditions
Firm, dark, greasy, olive-brown blotches on green and ripe tomato fruit
evidence_references: FAO IPM Guidelines on Oomycete Pathogens 2021
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Verified oomycete pathogen; explosive spread in cool wet weather. Present in both Dataset 1 and Dataset 2.

observable_symptoms: Pale green to yellowish diffuse spots on upper leaf surface
Dense olive-green to purplish-brown velvety mold on underside of corresponding leaf spots
Infected leaves wither, curl, and drop off prematurely
evidence_references: Cornell Tomato Leaf Mold Fact Sheet
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Olive velvety sporulation on lower leaf surface is diagnostic; prevalent in polyhouses and humid field canopies.

observable_symptoms: Mottling of leaves with alternating light green and dark green mosaic patches
Leaf distortion, blistering, puckering, and strap-like 'fern leaf' narrowing
Internal brown necrosis inside fruit and uneven ripening
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Mechanically transmitted Tobamovirus; 373 images in Dataset 2.

observable_symptoms: Numerous small, circular spots (2 to 3 mm diameter) with dark brown margins and gray/tan centers
Tiny black specks (pycnidia fruiting bodies) embedded in center of mature spots
Severe yellowing and leaf loss progressing from base of plant upwards
evidence_references: ICAR-IIHR Foliar Fungal Diseases of Tomato 2023
Ohio State Extension Septoria Leaf Spot Guide
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Tiny black pycnidia in lesion center distinguish it from bacterial spot; present in both datasets.

observable_symptoms: Fine yellow stippling, speckling, or flecking on upper leaf surface
Leaves turn bronze or grayish-brown and dry out
Fine silky webbing on underside of leaves and between petioles harboring tiny moving mites
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Acarine pest damage; webbing on leaf undersides is diagnostic.

observable_symptoms: Brown circular lesions with light brown centers and faint concentric zoning
Lesions typically smaller than early blight and surrounded by distinct chlorotic yellow halos
Deep, sunken, pitted brown lesions on tomato fruits
evidence_references: University of Florida Target Spot of Tomato Publication
diseases.uncertainty_notes: High visual similarity to Early Blight; yellow halo and smaller lesion size assist differentiation.

observable_symptoms: Upward cupping, curling, and reduction in size of leaflets
Interveinal and marginal chlorosis giving foliage yellowed appearance
Marked stunting of shoots, erect bushy appearance, flower drop, and complete failure of fruit set
known_look_alikes: Tomato leaf curl New Delhi virus (ToLCNDV)
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Whitefly-transmitted Begomovirus; severe stunting and upward cupping.

observable_symptoms: Drying and scorching of leaf margins and tips due to maturity senescence or moisture stress
Absence of discrete fungal blotches or water-soaked halos
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Abiotic desiccation / physiological leaf drying; 203 field images in Dataset 2.

observable_symptoms: Broad oblong-lanceolate rich green leaves, intact smooth blades, absence of necrotic blotches or rhizome rot
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Dataset 2 contains 197 field photographs.

observable_symptoms: Small, discrete reddish-brown to dirty-yellow spots on both upper and lower leaf surfaces
Spots rapidly coalesce into large irregular yellow-brown blotches arranged along veins
Leaves turn yellow and dry up prematurely from tips downward
evidence_references: ANGRAU Package of Practices for Turmeric 2024
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Characteristic Taphrina blotches along veins; 199 images in Dataset 2.

observable_symptoms: Progressive yellowing of lower leaves moving upward along margins, drying, and drooping
Water-soaked brown decay of pseudostem collar (easily pulls out from underground rhizome)
Soft, rotting, foul-smelling brown decay of mother and finger rhizomes with hollowed interior
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Oomycete soil-borne rot. Crucially supports non-foliar rhizome/tuber photos. 182 images in Dataset 2.

observable_symptoms: Uniform vibrant green linear leaves, absence of powdery mats, orange stripes, or brown pustules
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Dataset 1 laboratory cardboard images only.

observable_symptoms: Small, round to oval reddish-brown to cinnamon-brown pustules scattered randomly on upper leaf surface
Pustules rupture epidermis revealing dusty brown urediniospores
Surrounded by slight chlorotic halo; pustules never arranged in narrow stripes
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Randomly scattered round pustules differentiate it from linear stripe rust; Dataset 1 only.

observable_symptoms: White to grayish-white cottony or powdery fungal mats on upper leaf surfaces and stems
Chlorotic yellow spots visible under fungal mats
Aging mats turn dull gray-brown with embedded tiny black cleistothecia specks
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Fluffy white powdery mats are diagnostic; Dataset 1 laboratory cardboard images only.

observable_symptoms: Bright yellow to orange-yellow pustules arranged in narrow, parallel linear stripes along leaf veins
Linear stripes resemble stitched seams of yellow powder
Premature drying, chlorotic yellowing, and shriveling of affected leaves and grain heads
diseases.uncertainty_notes: Linear yellow stripe arrangement is pathognomonic. Favored by cool temperatures (10-18°C); Dataset 1 only.
